condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

1. CTA was mobilized as of beginning of 2020 2. 1st contract for Roof-top PV systems have been installed in Bolu without on-grid connection. 3. Manisa and Çorum PV works were shifted to 2nd contract for Roof-top PV sytems. Contract was signed on mid-summer of 2020 for 225 households in 22 Villages in 18 provinces. 4. Installation works at Manisa, Izmir, Çorum, Kastamonu, Yozgat, Trabzon, Artvin, Erzurum, Elazig, Adana, Kahramanmaras, Sanliurfa, Karaman, Ankara and Bilecik completed without on-grid connection, under 2nd Roof-top Pv contract. 5. Installation works for Çanakkale, Denizli, Burdur is under progress as of mid-November. 6. Short video documentary was completed for land based PV system and shared on social media by OGM and UNDP Turkey. 7. 1st Traning for local GDF Staff was completd at Ankara. However, hands on trainings at local GDF premises and at sites were postponed due to COVID19 pandemic. 8. Trainigs for households started.

1. Establishement of MRV System 2. Integration of MRV system to the GDFs web page 3. Completion of on-grid connection of 1st and 2nd Contracts of Roof-top PV system. 4. Initiation of co-financing system for the 3rd phase for roof-top PV system. 5. Completion of Trainings for local GDF personnel. 6. Completion of trainings for households 7. Completion of short documentar for Roof-top PV systems.

1. 1st Rooftop PV Contract, which consists of 30 houses were completed for 29 houses as 1 householder is a disabled person and her on-grid connection procures are still on-going due to bureaucratic reasons. 2. 2nd Rooftop PV Contract’s PV installations were completed for all 225 houses. 185 houses were grid connected and grid connection procedures for 40 houses are under progress 3. General Directorate of Forestry, Forest Village Relations (ORKOY) Department has initiated co-financed PV installations for 612 houses at 20 Provinces. However, due to delays in PV approval stages, the number has been reduced to 568 houses, as ORKOY has to finalize the payment of related credits before the end of each year. 4. Technical report for 1st and 2nd Phase Rooftop PV implementations were prepared 5. Case study for 1st and 2nd Phase Rooftop PV implementations were prepared 6. Workshop for dissemination of case study of 1st and 2nd phase PV implementations was done at Antalya with the participation of local and headquarters staff of ORKOY Department, Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources, Ministry of Environment Urbanization and Climate Change, Turkish Electricity Distribution Corporation, Municipalities, Provincial Special Administrations, Electricity utility Companies and Village headmen between 16-19 November 7. Short video Documentary footage has been completed. However, the footage needs to be edited by the company to be shorter so that it can be broadcasted on online platforms in an efficient and attractive way. 8. MRV Expert was mobilized 9. MRV System inline with ProDoc was prepared 10. Training of local GDF ORKOY staff continued by online means throughout the year and separate sessions were held during Antalya event between 16-19 November.

1. Co-financed roof top PV installations at 20 provinces for 400 houses 2. Completion of short Video Documentary for Roof Top PV system. 3. Communication activities for dissemination of PV Systems 4. Training of Local GDF Staff 5. Workshop for Electricity Utility Companies, TEDAS, EPDK and Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources 6. Capacity building activities for GDF HQ personnel 7. Round table meetings with finance institutions 8. Trainings for school children 9. Initiation of ORKOY financed PV installations

1. Co-financed on-grid connected roof top PV systems at 20 provinces for 681 houses completed 2. Short video documentary for Roof Top PV systems is completed. 3. Communication activities for dissemination of PV systems were done as planned. Please refer to evidence document for social media posts and TV news in national media. 4. Training of local GDF Staff Continued throughout the year. Trainings were held both face to face and online. Kizilcahamam Workshop (31.01.2022 - 02.02.2022), Antalya Training (23-25.06.2022) 5. Workshop for Electricity Utility Companies, TEDAS, EPDK and Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources were held at Kizilcahamam, Ankara between 31.01.2022 and 02.02.2022 6. SEFM Unit (Sustainable Energy Financing Unit at GDF HQ) and UNDP PIU visited Intersolar Europe to examine the latest technological developments in PV sector and to meet with PV contractors to discuss new financial methods. 7. Round table meeting with finance institutions were postponed to year 2023 as the contracting of international consultant, who will lead the meetings, could not be finalized yet 8. Trainings for school children and university students were completed in Zonguldak, Eregli and Düzce regions by reaching to 1082 school children and 350 university students. 9. GDF’s ORKOY Department will mobilize GDF only funds for Forest villagers for the year 2023. The Budget meetings for 2023 at the national parliament were still under progress while this ROAR was written. Therefore, the amount of budget allocation was not defined yet.
